title: Deliberately unreadable — too dark to read
instructions: This one is meant to fail, and it is the most valuable shot in the session: it is how the corpus checks that Buddy says "I cannot read this" instead of guessing.
Set the board back to the STARTING position.
Turn the lights off, or close the curtains, until the board is barely visible to you — a room where you would not sit down to play.
Do not use the phone's flash or night mode.
Take the photo. This is the LAST shot of the session — the phone may be moved freely afterwards.
